title: Sections of a sheaf over a disjoint etale cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a category, and $G$ an $A$-valued sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $V$ be an object of the site, $W_i$ an indexed family of objects, and $\pi_i:W_i\to V$ monomorphisms. Assume that their generated sieve is covering and that the images of the underlying scheme maps $\pi_i$ and $\pi_j$ are disjoint whenever $i\ne j$. If the categorical product of the $G(W_i)$ exists, the restriction map $G(V)\to\prod_iG(W_i)$ is an isomorphism. The index set is arbitrary, including empty.

source.place: Tag 03P9 (section-etale-site), sheaf condition for a disjoint etale covering; implemented in the proved source theorem Etale.isIso_piLift_of_disjoint

proof.text: A family of maps from an arbitrary test object E to G(W_i) is compatible on overlaps. For identical indices compatibility follows by the monomorphism cancellation property. For distinct indices the overlap has empty underlying space by disjointness; G has terminal sections there, by the empty-cover sheaf condition.

The sheaf condition existsUnique_amalgamation_ofArrows gives a unique section map E -> G(V) with these restrictions. Hence the restriction map induces a bijection on morphisms out of every E. Apply isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective, giving the asserted isomorphism.
